title: Shall Attain His Lord And Master
summary: The shabad does not leave seva at diagnosis. It turns toward return.
takeaway: shall attain his Lord and Master
lifeApplication: Do one hidden act of service that does not return to self-advertisement. After the reaction, make the next return smaller and truer.

source.shortMeaning: One who performs selfless service, without thought of reward
source.lifeApplication: Do one hidden act of service that does not return to self-advertisement. Let this line guide the first honest return after the reaction.

evidence.coreClaim: One who performs selfless service, without thought of reward
evidence.turn: Seva becomes transformative when the self stops trying to be seen through it.
evidence.practicalImplication: Do one hidden act of service that does not return to self-advertisement. After the reaction, make the next return smaller and truer.
